description: Permanently deletes an existing label from a Trello board by its ID; this operation is irreversible via the API.

idLabel.description: The unique identifier of the label to be deleted.
idLabel.title: Id Label

name: delete_labels_by_id_label

DeleteLabelsByIdLabelResponse.description:
Response schema for `DeleteLabelsByIdLabel`

Empty response body. The DELETE operation returns HTTP 200 OK with no content
upon successful deletion of the label. Trello API DELETE operations return 200
OK status with an empty or null response body rather than 204 No Content. The
successful deletion is indicated by the 200 status code alone.
